name: Directory Opus for Mac experiment (OpusMac) — open-source file manager archive
description: Directory Opus for Mac experiment: independent MIT-licensed dual-pane file manager for macOS and Windows, written in C#/.NET/Avalonia. Source archive for reuse; not official Directory Opus, not a finished Mac port.

implemented_component_entrypoints.limitation: Avalonia source/destination panes; Windows-tested code, not a finished Mac desktop experience.
Mutation owner and neighboring journal/revalidation code; test on disposable files before reuse.
Windows WIC / macOS Image I/O paths and a bounded cache; Mac orientation/color require native tests.
ZIP, duplicates, rename planning, split/join and comparison owners.
Optional independent companion protocol, not commercial Listary database access.
Exact commands and platform boundaries; known UI failure stays documented in VALIDATION.md.
